name: Printing Full Name with Middle Initial
description: Construct a program that prints the full name with middle initial for the name "John Phillip Smith".

comments.content: We define a string variable to hold the name.
We need to extract the first name from the full name. We do this by calling the substring(0,4) method.
The substring(0,4) method returns a string that is made up of the characters in the string fullName, starting at position 0 and continuing up to, but not including, the position 4.
We need to extract the first letter of the middle name from the full name. We do this by calling the substring(5,6) method.
The substring(5,6) method returns a string that is made up of the characters in the string fullName, starting at position 5 and continuing up to, but not including, the position 6.
We need to extract the last name from the full name. We do this by calling the substring(13,fullName.length()) method.

The substring(13,fullName.length()) method returns a string that is made up of the characters in the string fullName, starting at position 13 and continuing up to, but not including, the value returned by the length() method. Note that the length() method returns the number of characters in a string and the last position in the string is at position length()-1.
This statements concatenates the first name, middle initial and the last name and store the result in the string name.
This statement prints the name to the default standard output stream. The printed value is followed by the end-of-line character at the end.
